evidence: ORastma/LORastma/SElora and ORlrd/LORlrd/SElorL hold a study's asthma and LRD outcomes as columns, with covar the 'imputed covariance' between them, one row per study (ID 'study ID'); Year and Country are study covariates; long form AstLrd.sav (condition 'Astma ve LRD').
vial1-vial16 'estrone essay measurement (repeated)' are the replicate assays of one subject ('individual') as columns; long form estrlong.sav (estrmeas).
ALGEBRA and STATS are two different test scores with no id or group column; no documented model with a random effect, and the two columns are no repeated measure of one quantity.

study 'study identification' never repeats, one effect size d with varofd per study; weeks is the 'duration of intervention', a covariate; the meta-analytic study effect is observation-level, no unit the rows repeat within.

RATING1-RATING11 'sociometric rating' are the ratings among groupmates as columns, one row per CHILD; GROUP also nests children, but the repeated rating is spread across columns; long form SocsLong.sav (group, sender, receiver).
Y1-Y10 are the groups of Table 3.1 ('Statistical Treatment of Clustered Data') as columns, with no group column; the rows are members within the column groups.
id is unique per child; days (the count) over age (F0-F3), slow, aborig and girl, design factors of fixed levels; no cluster column.
y1-y4 are one woman's response at four occasions as columns; the rows are dose by response-pattern cells weighted by wt2, with no subject column.
weight1 (pre) and weight2 (post) are one patient's weight at two occasions as columns; treat (cbt, contrl, ft) is a fixed arm.
One row per student: attend, termgpa, priGPA, ACT, final, frosh and soph are student attributes; no id or cluster column.
rfn, rfc, rfi, rcn, rcc and rci are one subject's scores under six conditions as columns, subj unique; dependent is a subject-level group.
id 'Respondent's id' does not repeat, one marriage per row with dur and divorce a single-spell survival; weight is a sampling weight; ch15 fits single-level streg, no shared frailty.

id 'Respondent's id' repeats over marnum 'Marriage number' (an id holds marriages 1 and 2 in the first rows), so marriages repeat within respondent; time1-time17 and numkid1-numkid17 are the fertility spans stored wide, a time-varying covariate, not the response.
study never repeats, one estimate est with se per study (authors names it); the meta-analytic study effect is observation-level; weeks is a covariate.
ch1 fits only regress; one row per faculty member, yearsbg, yearsrank and yearsdg are durations in years, rank and male fixed factors; no cluster column.
id unique, one row per subject with time and censor (person-level survival); pt and pas are subject covariates, time a duration.
gpa1-gpa6 and job1-job6 ('1 gpa' to '6 gpa', '1 job' to '6 job') are one student's six semesters as columns, student unique.
grade1 and grade4 are two graders' grades of one essay as columns, essay unique.
length1/breadth1 and length2/breadth2 are the first and second son's head measurements as columns, one row per family, with no family column.
dep1-dep6 are one subject's depression scores at six occasions as columns, subj unique; group is the treatment arm, pre the baseline.
read0-read3, math0-math3 and age0-age3 ('0 read' to '3 read') are one student's four occasions as columns, id unique; ch7 reshapes to long before mixed read grade || id:.
One row per released inmate, durat and cens a single-spell duration; person '=1 if crime against person' is a binary, not an id.
score1-score4 are one patient's post-operative scores at four occasions as columns, id unique; dosage is a fixed design factor.
v1-v4 (V1-V4) are one patient's respiratory status at four visits as columns with bl the baseline, patient unique; center also clusters patients, but the repeated response is spread across columns.
regid 'Region identifier' (with regcode) repeats over the lon/lat 'Longitude'/'Latitude' vertices of each region's boundary polygon; the table is a map with no response.
traveler unique, alt the chosen mode with Ttime, Hinc and Psize; ch12 fits mlogit alt Hinc Psize, no random effect; the long version is travel2.
twin1 and twin2 hold the two members of a twin pair as columns, num2 the frequency of the pattern and dzmz the zygosity; no pair column.
obs 'observation number' unique; ch10 fits logit workstat husbinc i.chilpres; region 'Region where family lives' is a fixed locality category, not a sampled unit.
ALC1-ALC3 and PEER1-PEER3 are one person's three waves as columns, ID unique; long form alcohol2_pp.
ID unique, WEEKS and CENSOR one person-level survival time each; WEEKS is a duration, not a unit; a superseded copy of alcohol_relapse.
ID unique, WEEK and CENSOR a person-level survival time with NASAL a covariate; WEEK is a duration, not a unit.
ID and NAME unique per representative, TIME and CENSOR a person-level survival with DEM; TIME is a duration.
ID unique, TIME and CENSOR a person-level survival with ABUSED, BLACK and ABLACK; TIME is a duration.
ID unique, TIME and CENSOR a person-level survival with PT and PAS, the same data as rabe_hesketh firstsex.dta.
id unique per justice, tenure with dead, retire and leave; year is the appointment year, a covariate shared by justices appointed together, not a sampled unit.
ID unique, DAYS and CENSOR a continuous-time stay with TREAT; DAYS is a duration, not an id.
ID unique per monkey, SESSIONS to criterion with CENSOR, INITIAL_AGE, END_AGE, BODYWT and FEMALE; SESSIONS is a count.
id unique, months and censor with personal and property crime binaries and cage; personal is a binary, not an id.
MOOD1-MOOD12, WEEKMOOD1-WEEKMOOD12 and AVERMOOD00-AVERMOOD12 are one subject's repeated mood as columns, ID unique; DAYS and CENSOR the relapse time.
ID unique, TIME and CENSOR a person-level survival with AGE; TIME is a duration.
ID unique, TIME and CENSOR a person-level survival only; TIME is a duration.
TOL11-TOL15 are one adolescent's tolerance at ages 11 to 15 as columns, ID unique; long form tolerance_pp.
y0, y1, y4 and y6 are one child's blood lead at weeks 0, 1, 4 and 6 as columns ('four repeated measurements of blood lead levels'), id unique; trt a fixed arm.
y1-y4 are one child's lead levels at weeks 0, 1, 4 and 6 as columns, weeks 1 to 6 'set to missing under a missing at random (MAR) process'; id unique.
One row per infant, bpd (binary) over weight, gestage and toxemia; no id, no repeated measure, no cluster column.
id 'Subject ID' unique over 'a random sample of adult residents', y the ordinal impairment over le and ses; no cluster column.
y0 (baseline 8-week count) and y1-y4 ('2-week intervals before each of four successive post-randomization clinic visits') are one patient's counts as columns, id unique; long form stata_epilepsy.
id unique, y the seizure count of 'the final post-randomization 2-week interval only' over trt and age; no repeated measure in the table.
y0-y12 ('Response at Time 1' to 'Time 7', days 0 to 12) are one patient's strength as columns, id unique; group is the PROGRAM arm; long form stata_exercise.
y1-y4 ('Age 8 Response' to 'Age 14 Response') are one child's distance as columns, id unique, gender fixed; long form nlme Orthodont.
y1 'Pre-Treatment Bacilli Count' and y2 'Post-Treatment Bacilli Count' are one patient's two occasions as columns; drug (A, B, placebo C) a fixed arm.
y1-y5 ('Response at Baseline' to 'Month 24') are one patient's serum cholesterol as columns, id unique; group is the treatment arm (high dose, placebo).
y1-y5 are one rat's weight at weeks 0 to 4 as columns, id unique; group is the treatment (control, thiouracil, thyroxin).

y0-y4 ('Baseline Response', 'Visit 1 Response' to 'Visit 4 Response') are one patient's status as columns; clinic (1, 2) also clusters patients, but the repeated response is spread across columns; long form geepack respiratory.
id unique, tumor recurrence 'for the month 18 follow-up visit only' over trt; no repeated measure in the table.
y1-y4 ('Arthritis Categorical Scale month 0' to 'month 6') are one patient's ordinal scale as columns, id unique; trt and age fixed.
pextern 'Externalizing Behavior (Parent Report)' and textern '(Teacher Report)' are two informants' reports on one child as columns, cid unique; health and single are child covariates.
Y.t0-Y.t8 ('Measurements ... made at weeks 0, 1, 2, 4, 6, 8') are one subject's symptom severity as columns, indv unique; treat a fixed arm, n.obs, surv.time and cens.ind dropout summaries.
